Definition: from G2744; boasting (properly, the act; by implication, the object), in a good or a bad sense:--boasting, whereof I may glory, glorying, rejoicing.
BiblicalUsage: Kauchesis means boasting, the act of glorying: Romans 15:17 says, I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God. 1 Corinthians 15:31 has Paul protesting by his rejoicing in Christ Jesus, I die daily. 2 Corinthians 7:4 says great is my glorying of you, and 1 Thessalonians 2:19 asks, what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's boasting was never about Paul: it was about the people God gave him and the Christ who died daily in him. I hold that the best crown of rejoicing is not a thing, but people standing before the Lord at his coming.
